text: Look, I'm no scientist, but my doctor told me that switching to a more plant-based diet helped a lot of his patients with similar cholesterol issues. He's been practicing medicine for thirty years and has seen thousands of patients. I decided to give it a try, and my numbers improved within three months. I think more people should at least consider it.

annotations.quote: my doctor told me that switching to a more plant-based diet helped a lot of his patients with similar cholesterol issues

metadata.note: The speaker is citing a relevant authority (their own doctor, who has domain expertise) for a claim that is broadly supported by medical literature. This is closer to legitimate use of expert opinion than a fallacious appeal to authority. The speaker also frames it as personal experience rather than universal truth.
